scope: Source-certified numeric continuations, complete compound labels and kerned original signs; native-only.
rules: Two original native vertical rails with exactly corresponding endpoints and at least one full original horizontal end rule certify an open-top or open-bottom frame. Both ends open still decline. Interior grid rails, prior grids/roles and complete whole-frame ownership retain their authority.
A proven native baseline must lie inside the frame. Complete glyph rectangles remain inside every closed end; ascenders/descenders can cross only an open end.

The complete original terminal numeric field is split from the last fullwidth separator. All preceding source label words must bind in order; whitespace is ignored only for binding, while original line/cell bytes, ASCII and fullwidth gaps remain exact.

Unicode Roman numerals are allowed only as a leading whitespace-separated enumerator before a nonnumeric label. Extra amount lanes, embedded/nonleading numeric material and unsupported whole-frame numeric rows still decline. This is notation grammar, not financial account or page wording.

A detached sign needs its own unique original word on exactly the same native baseline, with its left and right edges preceding the corresponding first numeric-word edges. Partial printed kerning is allowed without a fixed distance/overlap threshold; wrong-row, competing, missing or covering signs decline.

Every numeric source row across the complete original frame must certify the same sole terminal amount rail and common empty label/value gap. Complete consecutive source rows render the exact old bytes and preserve every prior source occurrence.
